title: CBDT extends date of filing of Income Tax Returns (ITRs) due for filing by 31st July 2025 to 15th September 2025
text: The Central Board of Direct Taxes has extended the due date for filing income tax returns that were due on 31 July 2025 to 15 September 2025 for Assessment Year 2025-26, because of changes in the notified ITR forms and the time needed to update the filing utilities.

title: CBDT extends return filing deadline for audit cases to December 10
text: For Assessment Year 2025-26, the CBDT extended the due date for filing income tax returns of taxpayers whose accounts must be audited from 31 October 2025 to 10 December 2025. The due date of the tax audit report was extended to 10 November 2025.
notes: Audit cases only; the summary names two new dates (the ITR one is expected).

title: CBDT extends I-T return filing deadline for audited taxpayers to November 21
text: The CBDT extended the due date for filing the income tax return for Assessment Year 2026-27 for taxpayers under tax audit from 31 October 2026 to 21 November 2026, and the tax audit report from 30 September 2026 to 21 October 2026.

title: Govt extends deadline for filing GSTR-3B return by 5 days till Oct 25
text: By Notification No. 17/2025-Central Tax dated 18 October 2025, the due date of GSTR-3B for September 2025 (monthly filers) and for the July-September 2025 quarter (QRMP filers) was extended to 25 October 2025, five days after 20 October.

title: Date extension for filing GSTR-3B for taxpayers in five districts of Maharashtra
text: For GST taxpayers located in Mumbai City, Mumbai Suburban, Thane, Raigad and Palghar districts of Maharashtra, the due date for filing GSTR-3B for July 2025 is extended from 20 August 2025 to 27 August 2025 because of heavy rains (Notification No. 12/2025-Central Tax dated 20 August 2025).
notes: Only some districts of one state; we can only store the state.

title: CBIC extends due date of March GSTR-3B to 21st April 2026
text: Notification No. 01/2026-Central Tax extends the due date for furnishing GSTR-3B for the month of March 2026 by monthly filers from 20 April 2026 to 21 April 2026, after technical issues on the GST portal.

title: CBDT extends deadline for filing tax audit reports for AY 2025-26 to October 31
text: The CBDT extended the due date for furnishing tax audit reports for Assessment Year 2025-26 from 30 September 2025 to 31 October 2025.
notes: The tax audit report is not one of our 7 forms, so nobody should be flagged.

title: Recommendations of the 56th meeting of the GST Council
text: The GST Council recommended a simpler rate structure with two main slabs of 5% and 18% and a special rate for luxury and sin goods, effective from 22 September 2025.
notes: A tax rate change, not a filing deadline or filing rule of our forms.

title: GST collections rise 9.1% to Rs 1.89 lakh crore in September
text: Gross GST collections rose 9.1 per cent to about Rs 1.89 lakh crore in September 2025 compared with the same month last year.

title: CBDT extends due date for filing of Form 10B/10BB and Form ITR-7 for the Assessment Year 2023-24
text: For trusts and institutions, the CBDT extended the due date of the audit report in Form 10B/10BB for Assessment Year 2023-24 to 31 October 2023, and the due date of the return in Form ITR-7 from 31 October 2023 to 30 November 2023 (Circular No. 16/2023).
notes: Hard case: ITR-7 is for trusts, which the app does not track, but the form code is itr. Counted as relevant with form itr; the admin must reject it.
